import importlib.util, json, random, subprocess, sys
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mainmod", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

rng = random.Random(77)
alphabet = ["s%02d" % i for i in range(24)]
found = None
for trial in range(2000):
    atoms = []
    for i in range(10):
        op = rng.choice(("endswith", "contains"))
        atoms.append((op, [rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randint(12, 16))]))
    monitors = [mod._monitor(op, list(p), alphabet) for op, p in atoms]
    try:
        mod._build_product(monitors, len(alphabet))
    except mod.ReqError as exc:
        found = atoms
        print("found over-cap atom set at trial", trial, exc.code)
        break
if found is None:
    raise SystemExit("none found")
hidden = {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "false"},
                                {"op": "or", "args": [{"op": op, "path": p} for op, p in found]}]}
req = {"services": alphabet, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": hidden}], "queries": []}
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"],
                   input=(json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=120)
print("hidden branch ->", p.stdout.decode().strip()[:80])
req2 = {"services": alphabet, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": []}
